senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Eber, a descendant of Shem, believed to have maintained schools (oracles) in connection with Shem.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 63:10">Gen. R. s. 63</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 25:22">Gen. XXV, 22</cite>) <he>למדרשו של שם וע׳</he> to the school of Shem and Eber.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:7">Gen. R. s. 37</cite> <he>נביא גדול היה ע׳ וכ׳</he> E. was a great prophet, for he gave names alluding to coming events.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 37:7">Ib.</cite> s. 42 (expl. <he>העברי</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 14:13">Gen. XIV, 13</cite>) <he>שהוא מבני בניו של ע׳</he> because he is a descendant of Eber; a. fr.
